content: @simplewebauthn/browser npm package, current version 13.3.0 (verified via npm view this session), ~2.5M weekly downloads, repo MasterKale/SimpleWebAuthn. Exports startRegistration(optionsJSON) and startAuthentication(optionsJSON) which wrap navigator.credentials.create()/get() and handle all base64url/ArrayBuffer conversion, plus browserSupportsWebAuthn() and platformAuthenticatorIsAvailable() feature-detection helpers.
